backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing a waitlist and transient user profiles with admin/user permission checks using AccessControl.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text summaries of multiple frontend source files for reference or documentation.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment checklist detailing build, asset verification, backend checks, and deployment steps.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles with extensive OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes and utility resets.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading fonts, favicon, metadata, and mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app toggling between landing and admin views based on URL hash and rendering core sections.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminWaitl: Implements the admin dashboard for authentication, admin bootstrap, waitlist retrieval, and CSV export with login/logout controls.
frontend/src/components/chatbot/chatbotS: Defines chatbot intents and keyword matching logic that returns responses and optionally triggers the join-waitlist action.
frontend/src/components/chatbot/ChatbotW: Provides a floating chat widget that handles user messages, intent matching, assistant replies, and a toggleable chat UI.
frontend/src/components/countdown/Countd: Displays a countdown section announcing the bootcamp start date and embedding the CountdownTimer component.
Shows a live countdown to a target date or an expired message using values from a countdown hook.
frontend/src/components/faq/FaqAccordion: Renders an FAQ accordion with expandable questions and predefined answers about the bootcamp.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with branding, navigation links, bootcamp details, and attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive header with logo, navigation links, mobile menu, and Join Waitlist button.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Renders the landing-page hero section with background image, bootcamp details, and buttons for joining the waitlist or viewing the curriculum.
frontend/src/components/preview/Interact: Renders an interactive course preview with selectable weeks and detailed lesson info. Uses local state to switch between predefined preview data.
frontend/src/components/syllabus/Syllabu: Displays a four-week syllabus with icons and topic lists. Maps structured week data into styled curriculum cards.
frontend/src/components/waitlist/Waitlis: Provides a waitlist signup form that submits name and email via a mutation and handles success, errors, and loading states. Resets fields and shows feedback messages based on mutation results.
Wraps and presents the waitlist form with introductory text and styling. Highlights limited availability and cohort details.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s Internet Identity, reinitializing on identity changes. Invalidates dependent queries when the actor updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdown.ts: Provides a countdown hook that returns time remaining until a target date, updating every second. Marks expiration when the date passes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, identity loading, and status tracking. Wraps AuthClient setup and exposes identity to the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for waitlist operations, including adding entries and fetching the list via the backend actor. Handles actor readiness and admin confirmation gating.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets global Tailwind layers and theme variables using an oklch color palette, including dark mode overrides. Adds utility classes for gradients and shared styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, wrapping it in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider. Loads global styles and renders the root component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing), store/retrieve them in sessionStorage, and sync URL values with session persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, animations, container settings, and plugins.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, issues, and requests, emphasizing a shift to on‑chain waitlist storage and admin access to signups.
